thingdescriptiongroups.description: Thing Description containers. Each Group holds Thing Descriptions that are related in some application-defined way, such as all Things of a tenant, a fleet or a physical site

thingdescriptions.description: A W3C WoT Thing Description, served as a document. Each Version holds one complete WoT-TD 1.1 JSON-LD document

format.name: format
format.description: The document format. All Versions of a Thing Description share one format

wotid.name: wotid
wotid.description: The authored WoT identifier of this Thing Description - the value of the document's 'id' member, verbatim. It is the Resource source identity and the authority: the thingdescriptionid is a symbolic identifier constructed from it by a one-way construction that is never inverted. It MUST NOT encode a version

derivedfrom.name: derivedfrom
derivedfrom.description: The authored WoT identifiers of the Thing Models this Thing Description extends or composes - authored identifiers, not xids, so a resolver matches them against the document's own references directly

license.name: license
license.description: The license the document is offered under, as an SPDX license expression or a URL. Advisory provenance metadata

publisher.name: publisher
publisher.description: The organization that published the document. Advisory provenance metadata

standardsbody.name: standardsbody
standardsbody.description: The standards organization that defines or endorses the document, where one does, for example 'W3C' or 'OPC Foundation'. Advisory provenance metadata

canonicalurl.name: canonicalurl
canonicalurl.description: The canonical upstream location of the document, where it is also published outside this registry. Advisory provenance metadata

maturity.name: maturity
maturity.description: How established the document is, letting a Consumer prefer an official definition over an ad hoc one. Advisory provenance metadata that does not affect the semantic identity of the document

thingmodelgroups.description: Thing Model containers. Each Group holds Thing Models that are related in some application-defined way, such as all Thing Models published by one vendor or belonging to one product family

thingmodels.description: A W3C WoT Thing Model, served as a document. Each Version holds one complete WoT-TM 1.1 JSON-LD document

format.name: format
format.description: The document format. All Versions of a Thing Model share one format

wotid.name: wotid
wotid.description: The authored WoT identifier of this Thing Model - the value of the document's 'id' member, verbatim. It is the Resource source identity and the authority: the thingmodelid is a symbolic identifier constructed from it by a one-way construction that is never inverted. It MUST NOT encode a version

derivedfrom.name: derivedfrom
derivedfrom.description: The authored WoT identifiers of the Thing Models this Thing Model extends via 'tm:extends' or references via 'tm:ref' - authored identifiers, not xids, so a resolver matches them against the document's own references directly
